audit_scope: Offline saved-source verification; no package execution, builds, installs, downloads or existing publication edits.

snapshot.selection: Exact first 4000 rows in snapshot order; latest PyPI info.version at metadata fetch; one non-yanked sdist from that release; no historical fallback.
snapshot.ranking_window_evidence: Saved snapshot-provenance reports the September2026 calendar month; corrected commit metadata says Fix data for September. No new network verification.

archive_processing.safety_rules: No extraction. Read safe regular archive members only; reject absolute/traversal/backslash member names; ignore nested archives/binary suffixes; do not follow links. Recovery size cap128MiB per eligible text member was not reached by any eligible member.

named_type_scan.token_boundary_rule: ASCII identifier boundaries; UTF-8 decoded character offsets, physical LF line count. Token names are identifiers, not proof of instance-field access.
named_type_scan.physical_LF_source_line_policy: Compare raw UTF-8-decoded bytes split only at LF; preserve CR when present. Do not use Path.read_text universal-newline translation for character offsets or Python splitlines for GitHub line numbers.

saved_permalink_map.range_algorithm: Match package+archive member path+source SHA-256; validate1<=start<=end<=physical-LF source line count. For verified exact/newline-only identity maps, append #Lstart-Lend to the recorded40-hex commit blob URL. For partial maps, require the entire requested range within one exact matched source block, shift by github_start-source_start. Otherwise return null and retain frozen sdist URL/hash/member hash. Never infer a link from HEAD, tag name, package version alone, or another source hash.

limitations_and_real_corpus_gaps: 211 latest selected package releases have no current sdist; aaaaaaaaa is HTTP404. Their source usage is unknown, not zero. No historical release fallback or wheel-only source inference.

The follow-up named-token scan covers all saved native files and Unicode-bearing eligible text, not every member of all sdists. Eligible members were read, then retained only for recognized native suffixes/templates or Unicode indicators; .py requires an indicator. Other text is not available for this offline follow-up.

Ignored suffixes include .rst/.html/.json/.js/.css, binaries and nested archives. A binary/text heuristic rejects eligible members whose first256 bytes contain controls outside the allowed set; UTF-16 or unconventional encoded source can therefore be outside retained coverage.

244 symlinks are not followed. Targets present as retained regular source are covered under their regular names; other target presence/content cannot be proven from the retained-only catalog. No archive-member expansion is performed now.

Type-name token absence cannot exclude aliased types defined elsewhere, token-pasting, generic PyObject/raw offsets, differently named replicated layouts, dynamically generated C, or native/wheel sources absent from the sdist.

Lexical code status is not semantic access: declarations/definitions, sizeof/offsetof, cast helpers, generated/compatibility copies, inactive preprocessor branches and macro bodies need contextual review. The mask is a static regex lexer, not a compiler/parser, so language edge cases remain possible.

The saved409-file permalink map covers previous reviewed sources only; candidates not in it have no offline verified upstream mapping. Cached-source equivalence is rechecked locally, not refreshed against current GitHub. Partial maps support only contained exact ranges.
